The toilet broke! Water is leaking.
Walk into the Habitat (red sign) and hold F to fix it.
On the space station the toilet breaks sometimes, and astronauts fix it themselves. Water is precious: in 2023 the station learned to recycle 98% of its water, even from sweat and urine!
The toilet broke. Water leaks until the engineer fixes it.
The toilet is still broken: {0} water leaked today.
Moon dust covered a solar panel! The battery is draining.
Walk to the solar panel (red sign) and hold F to clean it.
Moon dust is sharp like tiny bits of glass and sticks to everything. Apollo astronauts (1969-1972) found it on their suits, tools and even in their noses.
Moon dust covered a solar panel. The battery drains until it is cleaned.
The solar panel is still dusty: the battery lost {0} today.
A tiny space rock hit a module! Air is leaking.
Go into the module with the red sign and hold F to patch the hole.
Micrometeoroids are space rocks smaller than a grain of sand, but they fly faster than 10 km every second. In 2016 a tiny piece hit a window of the space station and left a 7 mm chip.
A micrometeoroid made a hole. Oxygen leaks until it is patched.
The hole is still open: {0} oxygen leaked today.
